summary: Multiple waves of drones and missiles struck Kyiv and surrounding regions, including 6 Circon/Oniks missiles in 10 minutes and Geran-5 rockets toward Rivne and Volyn. A Russian military aircraft (Tu-154/Tu-95MS) crashed in Amur Oblast killing at least 3. Krivoy Rog's industrial base is collapsing with major metallurgical plants at standstill. Estonia accused Russia of sabotaging Milrem Robotics in Tallinn.
key_points: 6 Circon/Oniks missiles struck Kyiv area within 10 minutes causing explosions across the capital (Source: @UkraineNow/84371).
Reactive Shahed drones and Geran-5 missiles launched from Chernihiv and Zhytomyr regions toward Kyiv, Rivne, Volyn, and Irpin/Bucha (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75920).
Russian VKS struck a cargo ship carrying military supplies to AFU in NW Black Sea (Source: @tass_agency/397927).
Krivoy Rog defense council head declared city on brink of survival as all major metallurgical plants cease or run at 25% capacity (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33589).
Estonia accused Moscow of organizing arson at Milrem Robotics in Tallinn; company produces THeMIS UGVs used in Ukraine (Source: @eRadarrua/118461).
Russian Tu-154/Tu-95MS military aircraft crashed near Krasnoyarovo, Amur Oblast, 3 dead immediately, 2 died en route (Source: @eRadarrua/118501).
Defense Forces restored control near Kalynove; enemy advanced near Vasylivka and Shevchenka (Source: @DeepStateUA/23867).

sections.executive_summary: Multiple waves of drones and missiles struck Kyiv and surrounding regions, including 6 Circon/Oniks missiles in 10 minutes and Geran-5 rockets toward Rivne and Volyn. A Russian military aircraft (Tu-154/Tu-95MS) crashed in Amur Oblast killing at least 3. Krivoy Rog's industrial base is collapsing with major metallurgical plants at standstill. Estonia accused Russia of sabotaging Milrem Robotics in Tallinn.
ukraine: MP Sobolev stated winter will be very difficult, high-rise buildings cannot be supplied with electricity or water, urged citizens to relocate to country homes with generators (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33586).
Commander-in-Chief Drapaty lacks the same influence over army structures as predecessor Syrsky, who installed his own people in key positions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33584).
Lviv TCC checkpoint: recruiters smashed a car window to mobilize the driver (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33583).
Budanov warned Moscow that long-range strikes on Russia will become deeper and more powerful if the war continues (Source: @UkraineNow/84367).
Vinnytsia RSA head Natalia Zabolotnaya faces corruption investigation; first woman to hold the position after replacing acting head Borzov (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33582).

South Korea prisoner transfer dispute at UN escalated publicly; Seoul claims Kyiv violated confidentiality agreement, demanded apologies; $850M aid pledged including non-lethal support (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33604).
russia: Russian military aircraft (Tu-154, possibly Tu-95MS) from base Ukrainka crashed near Krasnoyarovo, Amur Oblast shortly after takeoff; 7 on board, 3 died immediately, 2 died en route (Source: @eRadarrua/118501).
Estonia officially accused Moscow of organizing arson at Milrem Robotics in Tallinn in mid-August; summoned Russian temp chargé d'affaires; Kremlin rejected accusations (Source: @eRadarrua/118461).
Kremlin expects Putin to attend APEC summit in China, calling it opportunity for meeting with US and Chinese leaders (Source: @tass_agency/397924).
Russia ready for continued close cooperation with Serbia leadership, expects continuity of ties (Source: @tass_agency/397923).
Putin promised to protect interests of Republika Srpska including in UNSC (Source: @tass_agency/397914).
Atlantic reported Trump backed easing sanctions on Russia in exchange for release of political prisoners (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33602).

Krivoy Rog defense council head declared city on brink of survival; Arcelor, Inhulets GOK, Pivdenny GOK, KZRK at standstill, other enterprises at max 25% pre-war output (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33589).

Reactive drone past Vyshgorod toward Kyiv Obolon district (Source: @kpszsu/81456).

air_war: Russian Tu-154/Tu-95MS military aircraft crashed near Krasnoyarovo, Amur Oblast; 7 servicemen on board, 3 died immediately, 2 died en route to hospital, fuel tanks exploded (Source: @eRadarrua/118501).
6 Circon/Oniks missiles used against Kyiv in 10-minute salvo (Source: @UkraineNow/84371).
Multiple Geran-5 missiles tracked: to Zhytomyr, Korosteen toward Rivne Sarny district, Irpin/Bucha, Volyn (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75889, @mon1tor_ua/75890, @mon1tor_ua/75920, @mon1tor_ua/75925).
Reactive Shahed drones launched from Chernihiv and Zhytomyr regions toward Kyiv region, Vyshgorod, right bank capital (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75920, @mon1tor_ua/75928).
Reactive drone from Zarechne Dnipropetrovsk region heading west (Source: @kpszsu/81457).
key_developments: 6 Circon/Oniks missiles struck Kyiv in 10 minutes alongside multiple Shahed and Geran-5 drones/rockets targeting Kyiv, Rivne, Volyn, and Irpin/Bucha from northern and western axes (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75920, @UkraineNow/84371).
Russian cargo ship carrying military supplies to AFU struck in NW Black Sea by Russian forces (Source: @tass_agency/397927).
Krivoy Rog defense council head declared city on brink of survival as all major metallurgical plants stop or operate at 25% pre-war capacity (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33589).
Russian military aircraft (Tu-154, possibly Tu-95MS) crashed in Amur Oblast killing at least 3 servicemen after takeoff from base Ukrainka (Source: @eRadarrua/118501).
Estonia accused Russia of organizing arson at Milrem Robotics Tallinn facility producing THeMIS UGVs used in Ukraine; Russian diplomat summoned (Source: @eRadarrua/118461).
Defense Forces restored control near Kalynove; enemy advanced near Vasylivka and Shevchenka (Source: @DeepStateUA/23867).
NATO Secretary General Rutte pledged increased support for Ukraine, signaling alliance message to Moscow (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33598).
sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting sustained multi-axis drone and missile campaigns against Kyiv and northern Ukraine using Shahed drones, Geran-5 missiles, and Circon/Oniks cruise missiles, indicating degraded Ukrainian air defense capacity and Russian willingness to expend long-range precision munitions. The Krivoy Rog industrial collapse signals deepening Russian economic pressure on Ukrainian infrastructure. The Tu-154/Tu-95MS crash in Amur Oblast represents a significant loss to Russian long-range aviation. Estonia's accusation of Russian sabotage at Milrem Robotics introduces a new dimension of hybrid escalation against NATO-adjacent defense industry targets.
sections.regional_response: NATO Secretary General Rutte pledged increased support for Ukraine, while Poland stated it will not unilaterally shoot down drones over Ukrainian territory, requiring NATO-level decision. South Korea faces bilateral tensions with Kyiv over prisoner transfer transparency, potentially affecting future non-lethal and humanitarian cooperation. Trump administration reportedly considering easing Russia sanctions in exchange for political prisoner release, which could undermine Western unity. Pope Leo XIV called for direct peace negotiations between Russia and Ukraine.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian Commander-in-Chief Drapaty appears to have less institutional control over army structures than predecessor Syrsky, who placed loyalists in key positions, potentially affecting operational coherence. Vinnytsia RSA head faces corruption allegations. Lviv mobilization enforcement involved property damage at a TCC checkpoint. Budanov's public warning about deepening strikes on Russia suggests Ukrainian long-range capabilities are expanding. South Korean public disclosure of prisoner transfer may compromise intelligence-sharing arrangements on North Korean military personnel in Ukraine.
